title: Reachability in the lifted graph
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph on $V$. Suppose every pair of vertices is connected by a finite sequence of neighbor steps, and suppose there is no Boolean coloring of $V$ that assigns opposite colors across every neighbor step. Then for every $u,v	o V$, there is a finite walk in the two-sheeted lift from $(u,	ext{false})$ to $(v,	ext{false})$, where each lifted step follows a neighbor step and flips the Boolean label.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is connected by finite sequences of neighbor steps
$G$ has no Boolean coloring that flips across every neighbor step
